summary: The ProfileHistory file appears to be part of an ASP.NET web application managing staff profiles and history. It involves displaying, filtering, and handling various sections of data related to staff history such as education, training, and certifications.
purpose: To manage and display different sections of a staff member's profile history, including filtering by specific types of entries such as education or training.

workflows.name: Profile History Data Binding
steps: Initialize StaffPRHistoryList with UserSession and StaffID.
Determine selected screen section, defaulting to 'ALL'.
Check for entry existence in specific sections such as Master, Profile, Training, etc.
Add relevant sections to ddScreenSection dropdown if they exist.
Bind data to gridData based on selected section.

conditions: If user session is null, data bind does not proceed.
If no dropdown item is selected, screen section defaults to 'ALL'.
system_behavior: Adds dropdown list items based on existent entries of specific types.
Binds data to a grid for a particular section or all sections.
